title: Sorting by Min orders by Min then description, with untracked parts mixed in by Min
custom_preconds: • Search " NOT" so the list has tracked and untracked parts with different Min values (e.g. untracked Min 0 and Min 3).
custom_steps:
1. Click the Min column header (ascending).
  2. Click it again (descending).
custom_expected:
Step 1:

  • Rows are ordered by Min, then by description within the same Min.
  • Untracked parts sit among tracked parts by their Min (not forced to the end).

Step 2:

  • Reverse Min order; untracked parts still placed by Min.
